#### Veeam

**Cloud Connect**

This dashboard gives visibility into Cloud Connect in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total events and unique tenants, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces top tenants, gateway pools, and subtenants. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a Cloud Connect operations view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
